g.text: Data: SpaceX Falcon User's Guide (May 2025) — limit loads, P95/50 acoustic MPE for the standard fairing (Eastern Range, 60 % fill), random-vibration MPE at the top of the payload adapter, shock
response spectra; GEVS = NASA GSFC-STD-7000B generalised qualification level for components up to 22.7 kg. Qualification adds 25 % (loads) or 3 dB (acoustics, vibration).
